McpFailureReport.description: An MCP server that failed to connect, or dropped and did not reconnect.

McpServerReport.description: The status of one MCP server a runtime hosts.

filtered_tools.description:
How many of the tools the server lists its `include_tools` and
`exclude_tools` filtered out (runtime protocol 1.6.0); absent when
none were.

instructions.description:
The `instructions` the server sent when it connected, at most 2,048
characters (runtime protocol 1.11.0): its summary in deferred tool
announcements. Absent when it sent none, or when its configuration
sets `instructions = false`.

message.description: Why the server failed, or what it is doing.

scope.description:
Where the runtime hosts the server (runtime protocol 1.5.0); absent
reads as `workspace`, which is all a runtime hosted before.

server_tools.description:
Every tool the server lists, by its own name and in its order, each
with whether the filters left it out (runtime protocol 1.9.0); empty
from older runtimes and while the server has listed nothing.

tools.description:
The names of its tools as the runtime declares them: one for each
unfiltered entry of `server_tools`, in the same order.

McpServerScope.description:
Where a runtime hosts an MCP server (runtime protocol 1.5.0; client
protocol 1.13.0). Open: a value this build does not know reads as
`workspace`.

oneOf.description:
One process per runtime, started when the runtime initializes and
shared by every workspace instance; its tools are the runtime's own,
outside any instance.

One process per workspace instance, started when the instance
opens.

McpServerState.description:
Open: a state this build does not know reads as `disconnected`, which
offers no tools and is not retried as a failure.

oneOf.description:
The connection dropped and is being re-established: its tools stay
declared and calls fail with `runtime_unavailable`.

McpServerTool.description:
One tool an MCP server lists, by the server's own name: the name its
`include_tools` and `exclude_tools` match (runtime protocol 1.9.0, client
protocol 1.36.0).

always_load.description:
The server's `always_load` or `always_load_tools` sends it up front
on a model that loads deferred tools (runtime protocol 1.11.0, client
protocol 1.47.0).

filtered.description: The server's filters left it out, so it is not offered.

failures.description: Servers that failed since the last report, in order.

servers.description: Every server the instance hosts, in name order.
